question: In which year was the National Institute of Kathak Dance established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1964**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• National Institute of Kathak Dance, also known as ____Kathak Kendra__. 
 
• It was Established in 1964 (the institution became a part of the Sangeet Natak Akademi).
 
• It is the premier dance institution for the Indian classical dance form of Kathak, and a unit of the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance and Drama, situated in New Delhi.
 
• The institution is primarily dedicated to Kathak, though it also offers courses in Hindustani classical music (Vocal) and Pakhawaj and Tabla.
 
• Kathak Kendra was originally established as the Kathak wing of the Shriram Bharatiya Kala Kendra, in 1955, through the efforts of Nirmala Joshi, the first secretary of the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• Here Pandit Shambhu Maharaj, celebrated Guru of the Lucknow Gharana (school) of Kathak, was head of the department. 
 
• Shambhu Maharaj received the highest award of the Sangeet Natak Akademi, the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship in 1967.
 
• Birju Maharaj a Kathak dancer was his nephew.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__Sangeet Natak Akademi__

 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi is constituted of three main units. The two of these units are dance teaching Institutes, as given below.
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy, called JNMDA located in Imphal.
 
• Kathak Kendra is located in Delhi.
 
• The President of India appoints the chairman of this Akademi. 
 
• The term of office for the chairman is of 5 years. 
 
• The duties, responsibilities, and functions of Sangeet Natak Akademi have been described in the Academy’s Memorandum of Association.
